pages.title: Plain Fairies
pages.text: Small, and they drift through forests and plains. Left alone, a fairy is harmless, just a little clingy. She follows whoever is holding something she wants.$(br2)A cake is a proper meal, and she throws you Fairy Dust for it — worth the trip.$(br2)Cookies are one of the foods she likes too. What you get back for one is a flower.

pages.title: Fairy Dust
pages.text: Right-click a flower with it and the dust draws a thread toward the nearest character home — which is how you find where somebody lives when all you have is a garden.

pages.title: Fairy Cake
pages.text: Decorate a cake with Fairy Dust and it takes on a flavour fairies prefer — a slice of it is enough to satisfy one.$(br2)Eating one yourself works too: the taste is faint, and it leaves you floating for a while.
